title: Concert ticketing: a versioned availability cache that still serves stale seat counts
name: Seat availability cache

questions.prompt: During the on-sale, fans kept seeing seats in sections that had sold out, clicked Buy, and got an error. Other sections showed "sold out" for a full minute after refunded seats went back on sale. It happens under heavy traffic, never in staging. Fix VersionedCache in tickets/versionedCache.ts so the tests pass.
